resources.string: See which sources are recording and which cameras are waiting.

Recording counts come from the recorder, not the preview. A waiting preview can coexist with a working recorder. Recovery follows camera availability; stopped recovery resumes only after the scheduler receives a new eligibility event. Quit and reopen only when ready to stop recording.
Camera in use or blocked by another app
Automatic recovery stopped; waiting for camera availability or a new session
Camera paused or unavailable in the current app/screen state
Source absent from the running pipeline; check mapping and reopen to apply changes
Camera frames available; waiting for preview
Use Camera status for details and diagnostics
Selected for this recording; not writing now
Not part of the current recording
